items.title: Beam.win
items.source_text: Beam.win Run AI agents on one Mac and use its windows on another Keep your agents and builds running on a Mac mini or Studio. Beam brings their Terminal, browser and other app windows onto the Mac in front of you, each as its own window with a Dock icon and ⌘Tab presence. Encrypted between your Macs. Free to try. items.title: readywhen
items.source_text: readywhen The senior personal assistant that works inside WhatsApp readywhen is the senior Personal Assistant that works inside WhatsApp. It has its own phone number, its own computer, and a project board that keeps track of everything on your plate. Call it. Message it. Voice-note it. And it gets real work done. Productivity Messaging Artificial Intelligence

items.title: walkai-talkai
items.source_text: walkai-talkai Talk to your AI coding agent over a walkie-talkie Press PTT on any handheld radio and talk to your AI coding agent, hands-free. walkai-talkai transcribes your voice on your Mac with local Whisper, types the command into Cursor, Claude Code or Antigravity (or calls OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek or Ollama directly), then speaks the answer back over the radio with neural voice, VOX tones and a roger beep. Your radio audio never leaves your Mac. macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon. One-time lifetime license, no subscription. Developer Tools Radio Vibe coding

items.source_text: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor.
